title: Neglected Tropical Disease Screening Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Match chronic symptom clusters to locally prevalent neglected tropical diseases and confirm with the lowest-burden definitive tests available.
Escalate outbreaks, cluster detection, or severe dehydration/invasive disease features to public-health and inpatient pathways immediately.
Link diagnosis support to treatment availability, reporting duty, and community follow-up rather than diagnosis alone.

title: Clinical Trial Eligibility Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Ground eligibility scoring in disease stage, biomarker status, performance status, and exclusion criteria rather than condition keyword matching alone.
Escalate uncertain eligibility to research staff review before patient outreach or referral decisions.
Track inclusion and exclusion rationale transparently so AI scoring remains reviewable and auditable.
